author: AbusiveUser
body:
Hello! My name is AbusiveUser and today I'm introducing a new map called Mystic Desert for the new 'possible' gamemode Arcade.
In this map the runners need to run for their lifes and try to destroy the main core to win but some people will try to stop them!
The map is inspired on the original gamemode created for OCN by SheriffSoco - Crossfire

Objective:
  • Runners: You as a runner, you need to run very fast avoiding obstacles (like cacti) and arrows from the snipers, then destroy the main core to win the match! (You can not leave the map and camping is illegal)
  • Shooters: You as a sniper, you have to shoot every people that is running and try to stop them before they break your core! (Snipers have 1 bow with Power 5, Infinity and Punch I)



Creator: AbusiveUser
Server hosted by: Local Host
Gamemode: Arcade (Atlas)
Recommended Size:
  • Shooters: 6 (3 per side)
  • Runners: 25
Building Time: 1 week.
Feedback: Junr, ALM and PieZ

- - - - - - - - - - - - - -
  • Full Imgur Album: http://imgur.com/a/pw8cB (UPDATED)
  • Download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/v5zdt5hfq1l62a1/Mystic+Desert.rar
Well, that's all for today, remember that feedback is always appreciated and it will help me improve in our future maps. If you have any questions about my map, ask in the comments and I will try my best to answer quickly.
Thanks, ~Abusive!
